judgement.reason: Mattermost is a single Go web server on PostgreSQL that can store files in S3, so contained changes such as a source-building Dockerfile and S3 file storage make it run.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /mattermost/data (server/build/Dockerfile), VOLUME /mattermost/config (server/build/Dockerfile), VOLUME /mattermost/plugins (server/build/Dockerfile), VOLUME /mattermost/client/plugins (server/build/Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile declares volumes for data, config and plugins, and no shown setting selects S3 file storage or database-backed config, so the default local file storage and config file need durable disk.
